reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: Estoy muy satisfecha con el jabón. Tiene una textura suave y agradable, limpia la piel en profundidad sin resecarla y deja una sensación de frescura y suavidad después de usarlo. Me gusta mucho porque es delicado con la piel y ayuda a mantenerla con un aspecto limpio y saludable.
reviews.zh: 我對呢塊肥皂非常滿意。質地柔軟舒服，可以深層清潔皮膚但唔會令皮膚乾燥，用完之後有清爽又柔滑嘅感覺。我好鍾意因為佢對皮膚好溫和，可以保持皮膚乾淨健康嘅狀態。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: Bought it for my teenager son and already after a couple os uses he felt and noticed improvement in his black heads condition. The foam dries the skin a bit so I recommend to use a good moisturizer after shower.
reviews.zh: 買俾我個青少年仔用，淨係用咗幾次佢已經感覺到黑頭情況有改善。泡沫用完皮膚會有少少乾，所以建議沖完涼之後用一支好嘅保濕產品。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: The foam cleanser is very gentle and comfortable on the skin. It cleans well without stripping or causing tightness. My skin feels fresh, smooth, and calm after washing. Perfect for daily use.
reviews.zh: 呢個泡沫潔面乳對皮膚非常溫和舒適。清潔力夠但唔會過度清潔或者令皮膚繃緊。洗完之後皮膚感覺清爽、柔滑、平靜。非常適合每日使用。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: nice foaming cleanser, doesn't seem to strip the skin
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅泡沫潔面乳，似乎唔會過度帶走皮膚油脂。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: リピ！とってもさっぱり！少しの量で大丈夫なので、もちがいいです！毛穴もさっぱりだし、めっちゃオススメ！
reviews.zh: 回購！超清爽！只需要少量就夠，所以好襟用！毛孔都清爽晒，超級推薦！

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: Cleansing Foam gently cleanses the skin without drying it out. It foams well and leaves the skin feeling fresh and comfortable. Suitable for daily use, especially for sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 潔面泡沫溫和地清潔皮膚，唔會令皮膚乾燥。起泡效果好好，用完皮膚感覺清爽舒服。適合每日使用，特別適合敏感肌。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: Excellent cleanser! Foams wonderfully and cleans the face perfectly. It might be a bit harsh for dry skin, but it’s perfect for oily skin.
reviews.zh: 非常出色嘅潔面乳！起泡效果好神奇，塊面清潔得好乾淨。對乾性皮膚可能會有少少刺激，但對油性皮膚就完美。

reviews.shade: KSECRET Seoul 1988 Cleansing Foam: Pine Cica 1%+Probiotics 150ml
reviews.text: “The cream has an incredible, milky texture. You literally need just a pea-sized amount, because it lathers so well and creates a rich, dense foam. After washing, my skin doesn’t feel tight or dry at all — even though I expected it to, it actually doesn’t dry out the skin. Even my perimenopausal skin, which is prone to dryness, feels comfortable. I’m really impressed.”
reviews.zh: 呢個霜有種難以置信嘅奶滑質地。你基本上只需要一粒豆仔咁大嘅份量，因為佢起泡效果好好，可以搓出豐富濃密嘅泡沫。洗完之後皮膚完全唔會繃緊或者乾燥 — 即使我以為會，但實際上佢真係唔會抽乾皮膚水分。即使我係容易乾燥嘅更年期前期皮膚，都感覺好舒服。我真係好驚喜。
